blurb: Guests play paintball in wooded outdoor fields with rental gear including markers, goggles, tanks, and optional body armor. Various packages offer different amounts of paintballs and game time, with private pavilions and dedicated hosts for groups. Activities include team building, corporate outings, birthday parties, bachelor/bachelorette parties, and walk-in recreational games.
